title: The First Month
description: Vyktor has the first-month polling. Sixty-one percent approval. The real question is what you do with the political capital before the budget cuts begin to bite.

title: The Architect's Question
description: Jonas has asked you to come by his study. His tone on the phone was the careful kind — the kind he uses when he's been rehearsing what he wants to say.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora submitted a records request to the Halvek Era Crimes Archive. She has what came back and she wants to talk.

title: Sons of Chancellors
description: Tomas was bullied at school. Jonas handled it, but Tomas needs his mother — not the Chancellor, just his mother.

title: Budget Allocation — Cabinet Review
description: The first draft budget is circulating among ministers. Maric wants more for labor. Vostane wants less deficit. Both think you're listening to the other one more.

title: The Archbishop's Invitation
description: Archbishop Renek extended an invitation during inauguration week. You haven't responded yet. The Church runs more hospitals than the state — ignoring the invitation is itself a statement.

title: The Faces on the Wall
description: Eleven thousand framed portraits of Chancellor Halvek still hang in government offices across Veltria. The clerks are asking what happens to them. The Archdiocese and the Interior Ministry have opinions.
